sentences.text: 2. Instant appeal has been filed for compensation on the ground that her vehicle i.e. Maruti Swift bearing registration No.CG-04-HB-5627 was damaged in the accident occurred on 12.08.2013.
Learned Claims Tribunal after hearing the parties and perusing the material available on record

,
dismissed the claim petition filed by the claimant.
3. On 10.04.2024, none appeared on behalf of the appellant to press this appeal.

Today also, when the case is called out for hearing even in the second round, none appears nor any representation made on behalf of the appellant to press this appeal.
4.
In view of above, this Court has left with no other option but to dismiss the appeal for want of prosecution.
5. Accordingly, instant appeal is dismissed for want of prosecution.

Sd/-
